objective: Introduce an exciting, truthful, read-only Kingdom Treasury relic journey while documenting a safe future badge mastery architecture; do not change server awards, live points, character levels, map, ads, or production.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main source SHA verified via GitHub; installed production OTA and RC artifact fingerprints not independently verified. This DEV branch is not production evidence.
chosenApproach: Derive item journey from current server-provided Shard snapshot and catalog; render a themed four-item path with next unlock, keeping purchases under existing server RPC and offline denial.
selectionRationale: Provides visible game progression with no speculative migration or new grant logic. Avoids regressions to existing bank, character switching or advertising.
alternativeApproaches: Create new server badge tiers immediately: rejected without verified authoritative activity receipt and RLS rollout.
Offer client-minted random rewards: rejected as insecure and financially confusing.
Read-only Treasury item journey and source-authored evolution blueprint: selected.
